applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (All India Financial Institutions – Responsible Business Conduct) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: No action required as the provisions are purely discretionary for All-India Financial Institutions.
answer.action_quote: An AIFI at its discretion, may provide relief measures such as waiver / reduction of various fees and charges

effective_date.quote: The above amendment shall come into force with effect from July 1, 2026.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (All India Financial Institutions – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions
